articles.summary: PR Newswire: Paradigm Health Announces Collaboration with the FDA to Transform Regulatory Review of Clinical Trial Data. articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: FDA Turns to AI to Speed Up Clinical Trials. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration seeks to accelerate clinical trials of new medicines by using artificial intelligence to streamline the laborious process of collecting and submitting study data.
